operators.name: max_pool2d_with_indices_forward

returns.shape: pooled: [N, C, H_out, W_out], indices: [N, C, H_out, W_out]

semantics: Equivalent to F.max_pool2d_with_indices(input, kernel_size=(kernel_h, kernel_w), stride=(stride_h, stride_w), padding=(padding_h, padding_w), dilation=1, ceil_mode=False, return_indices=True).
Output height = floor((H_in + 2*padding_h - dilation*(kernel_h-1) - 1)/stride_h) + 1, similarly for width.
Indices are flattened offsets within each channel (i*W_in + j), returned as int64 tensor.
Applies 2D max pooling with kernel (3,5), stride 1, padding (1,2), dilation 1, ceil_mode False, return_indices True.
Input shape [16,3,1024,1024] produces output shape [16,3,1024,1024] (since stride=1 and padding chosen).
Returns tuple (pooled float32, indices int64) both CUDA contiguous.
Returns the pooled tensor only (first element of tuple).
